takes.title: Walk around with Repeated Changes of Heading
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts mid-stride, turns through several headings with a low arm swing, and continues stepping in profile through the last frame.

takes.sourceDescription: vignettes - fists up, wipe window, yawn, stretch, angrily grab, smash against wall
takes.title: Alternate Face-Level Gestures and Forward Reaches
takes.actionDescription: The performer lifts a hand near the face, lowers the arms between gestures, then repeats one-handed and two-handed extensions. They settle with arms at the sides.

takes.sourceDescription: vignettes - fists up, wipe window, yawn, stretch, angrily grab, smash against wall, lift open window, throw punches, skip
takes.title: Move from Standing Reaches into Steps and Arm Gestures
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts upright, raises one arm, and shifts into wider steps and compact hand gestures with pauses. The take returns to a relaxed standing stance.

takes.sourceDescription: vignettes - fists up, wipe window, grab, lift open window, throw punches, yawn, stretch, walk, jump
takes.title: Alternate Short Steps and Upper-Body Gestures
takes.actionDescription: The performer changes heading while stepping, alternates compact arm motions and wide reaches, and slows to an upright stance near the end.

takes.sourceDescription: vignettes - throw punches, grab, skip, yawn, stretch, leap, lift open window, walk, jump/bound
takes.title: Switch Between Hand Gestures, Quick Steps, and Hops
takes.actionDescription: The performer combines arm gestures with several short stepping and hopping passages, with upright resets in between. The last pose stays side-on with knees bent.

takes.sourceDescription: vignettes - yawn, stretch, walk, run/jog, angrily grab, jump, skip, halt
takes.title: Walk, Jog, and Add High-Knee Steps
takes.actionDescription: The performer moves between walking and jogging, pauses for shorter gestures, and resumes higher knee lifts and quick steps. They finish with a slower stride.

takes.sourceDescription: vignettes - lift open window, smash against wall, hop, walk, run/jog, yawn, stretch
takes.title: Gesture, Step Sideways, and Finish with Quick Footwork
takes.actionDescription: The performer alternates short arm motions with steps and turns, then increases the pace and lifts the knees in the closing passage.
